capabilities: Render a Bases view as a kanban board
Drag and drop cards between columns and reorder columns
Customize column colors and card sizes
Sync card metadata with Markdown frontmatter
Auto-save board layout and column order to the vault
extras: Manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff; installation requires cloning the repository and building it yourself.
problem: Obsidian's Bases offer table views of notes but no visual kanban board for organizing tasks as draggable cards.
summary: Kanban board plugin that renders Bases as draggable-card boards with columns synced to Markdown frontmatter.
